title: Where Did nSWBOOT0 Go?
content:
Previously I used Programmer v2.15 on H5 MCUs to zero (uncheck) nSWBOOT0. Probably due to Windows drivers updates, I could no longer connect.

I updated to Programmer v2.23 and I can now connect, but I no longer see nSWBOOT0 anywhere. Where did it go?

scraped_replies.html:
Hello ​@mccabehm ;

 

Which STM32 are you using STM32G0 or STM32H5?

Could you please share the device number? 

According references manuals, the nSWBOOT0 bit isn’t supported in STM32G0 and STM32H5 devices.

I recommend you to look at Introduction to system memory boot mode on STM32 MCUs - Application note application note to boot from system memory.

 

Thank you. 

Kaouthar

STM32H563. Yes, I see that the reference manual has no mention of nSWBOOT0.

Apparently Programmer v2.15 displayed nSWBOOT0 (I know I saw it); and v2.23 doesn’t display it.

Then any change in behavior I thought I saw after unchecking nSWBOOT0 was imaginary 🙂
